name: FullPageOverlayLoader
description: A full-page, fixed-position overlay with a centered spinning loader icon. Used to block interaction and indicate a global loading state.

accessibility.keyboard: No keyboard interaction. The overlay covers the entire viewport.
accessibility.aria: No explicit ARIA attributes. Consider adding role="status" and aria-label for screen readers in production use.
accessibility.notes: This component renders a fixed overlay at z-50 with a semi-transparent white background (bg-white/80) and a spinning Loader2 icon.
